nodes.summary: Let the men and the women form finite sets of the same size, with strict preferences. Some stable perfect matching `μ` is weakly preferred by every man to every stable perfect matching: for every stable `ν` and every man `m`, `m` does not prefer `ν(m)` to `μ(m)`.
nodes.title: Existence of a man-optimal stable matching, through the men's join

nodes.summary: Let `μ` and `ν` be stable perfect matchings. The perfect matching that gives every man the partner he prefers among `μ(m)` and `ν(m)` is stable.
nodes.title: The men's join of two stable matchings is stable

nodes.summary: A woman whom `m` prefers to his join partner he also prefers to his partner in `μ`.
nodes.title: Preferred to the join, preferred to the first partner

nodes.summary: A woman whom `m` prefers to his join partner he also prefers to his partner in `ν`.
nodes.title: Preferred to the join, preferred to the second partner

nodes.summary: Each man's join partner is his preferred partner.
nodes.title: Each man's join partner is his preferred partner

nodes.summary: The men's best partner is one of the two partners.
nodes.title: The men's best partner is one of the two partners

nodes.summary: If `μ` and `ν` are stable, no two distinct men prefer the same woman among their two partners.
nodes.title: The men's join of two stable matchings is injective

nodes.summary: For perfect matchings `μ` and `ν`, man `m` receives the partner he prefers among `μ m` and `ν m` (Roth, *Econometrica* 54 (1986), Lemma 2, the choice set `Ch(x(h) ∪ y(h))` with quota one).
nodes.title: Men's pointwise best partner

nodes.summary: Each woman's partner in the men's join is one of her two partners.
nodes.title: Each woman's partner in the men's join is one of her two partners

nodes.summary: For stable perfect matchings `μ` and `ν` between finite sets of men and women, the men's join is the perfect matching that gives every man the partner he prefers among `μ(m)` and `ν(m)`. It is a perfect matching because the map is injective and the two sides have the same size.
nodes.title: Men's join of two stable matchings

nodes.summary: No man prefers his first partner to the join.
nodes.title: No man prefers his first partner to the join

nodes.summary: No man prefers his second partner to the join.
nodes.title: No man prefers his second partner to the join

nodes.summary: Let `μ` and `ν` be stable. No woman prefers her partner in the men's join to her partner in `μ`. Together with the companion statement for `ν`, every woman receives in the men's join the partner she likes less among her two partners: what the men gain together, the women lose together.
nodes.title: Opposition of interests: no woman prefers her men's-join partner to her first partner

nodes.summary: Let `μ` and `ν` be stable. No woman prefers her partner in the men's join to her partner in `ν`. With the companion statement for `μ`, every woman receives the partner she likes less among her two partners.
nodes.title: Opposition of interests: no woman prefers her men's-join partner to her second partner

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
